verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents that users can "approve time off requests from anywhere" alongside payroll, and that time tracking is an add-on in the same system without moving data. That is a thin first-party mention covering only the approvals element of the story. Missing for 10: PTO policy definition, accrual rules/calculation, evidence that approved PTO flows automatically into payroll, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
